message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/bin/fuzz/config_fuzzer.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":43,"var":"data/size","code":"memcpy(static_data, data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a mutable buffer before parsing."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_open_for_fuzzing","line":777,"var":"len","code":"return config_init_data(config, data, len - 1);","note":"The copied bytes become the exact parser span."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_init_data","line":792,"var":"lexer.pos/end","code":".pos = data, .start = data, .end = (char *)data + len,","note":"The lexer tracks the attacker-controlled end pointer for the input."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"lex_config","line":440,"var":"chr","code":"if (chr == '{') { emit(lexer, LEXEME_OPEN_BRACKET); return lex_config; }","note":"An opening brace is tokenized directly and can change parser control flow."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"parse_config","line":655,"var":"lexeme->type","code":"case LEXEME_OPEN_BRACKET: return parse_section;","note":"The open-bracket token transitions the parser into section parsing."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"parse_section","line":606,"var":"lexeme->value","code":"lwan_strbuf_append_str(&parser->strbuf, lexeme->value.value, lexeme->value.len);","note":"The section name bytes are copied into the parser scratch buffer before emission."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-config.c","function":"config_isolate_section","line":861,"var":"pos","code":"pos = isolated->parser.lexer.pos;","note":"Section isolation records the current lexer position before scanning for the matching end."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')))
print('trace updated')
PY` executed with exit code 0.
